definitions.name: U1C.REDUCE
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: bracket string -> its reduced form after deleting adjacent () and [] pairs (six rounds suffice for 12 characters)

definitions.name: U1C.BDELTA
definitions.body: 'INP' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ 1 -1 1 -1 ] RECORD 'TBL' BIND INP CHARS [ 'CH' BIND TBL CH GET ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket string -> vector of +1 for an opener and -1 for a closer, per character

definitions.name: U1C.ABSV
definitions.note: elementwise absolute value of a Vector (MAX of x and -x)

definitions.name: U1C.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its first largest element

definitions.name: U1C.SPJOIN
definitions.body: [ CHARS [ ' ' ] CONCAT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS -1 DROP JOIN
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: U1C.UP1
definitions.body: CHARS 'CH' BIND CH 0 GET UPPER CH 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: String -> same String with its first character in upper case

definitions.name: U1C.CAP
definitions.note: word -> lower case with first letter upper case

definitions.name: U1C.STARTIDX
definitions.body: 'F' BIND 0 F LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE F 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> indices of its TRUE positions

definitions.name: U1C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'A' BIND A 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT A -1 DROP CONCAT 'P' BIND A P SUB [ 0 EQ NOT ] MAP U1C.STARTIDX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> indices where a new run of equal adjacent values begins (index 0 always)

definitions.name: U1C.SPANS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 'SS' BIND SS 1 DROP N 1 COLLECT CONCAT SS SUB
definitions.note: start indices and total length n -> length of each segment

definitions.name: U1C.SUMREC
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: ledger entries -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts

definitions.name: U1C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'SV' BIND SV LENGTH 'N' BIND SV N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SV N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a Vector of exact numbers

definitions.name: U1C.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V U1C.MED 'MD' BIND MD SUB U1C.ABSV U1C.MED
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of exact numbers

solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'L' BIND L L [ 1 GET ] MAP U1C.ARGMAX GET

solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ U1C.CAP ] MAP U1C.SPJOIN
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT U1C.SPJOIN

solutions.prose.freq_top: G0A.WORDS TALLY 'TT' BIND TT KEYS TT VALUES U1C.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN

solutions.runs.upruns: 'A' BIND A 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT A -1 DROP CONCAT 'P' BIND A P GT NOT U1C.STARTIDX A LENGTH U1C.SPANS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'A' BIND A U1C.STARTS 'S' BIND A S GET
solutions.runs.majority: 'A' BIND A TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES U1C.ARGMAX 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET NIL T VALUES I GET 2 MUL A LENGTH GT SELECT

solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ 'X' BIND 1 0 X NIL? SELECT ] MAP 'M' BIND M U1C.STARTS 'S' BIND M S GET G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ 'X' BIND 1 0 X NIL? SELECT ] MAP 'M' BIND M U1C.STARTS 'S' BIND S M LENGTH U1C.SPANS M S GET MUL 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'IN' BIND IN 1 DROP IN -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'IN' BIND IN IN [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P 1 DROP P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND M DIV
